note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for PL-300, 'Skills measured as of April 20, 2026'. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Prepare the data
subtopics: Identify and connect to data sources or a shared semantic model
Change data source settings, including credentials and privacy levels
Choose between Direct Lake, DirectQuery, and Import storage modes
Create and modify parameters
Profile data and resolve inconsistencies, nulls, and import errors
Transform columns, group and aggregate rows, pivot and unpivot
Merge and append queries, and choose between reference and duplicate

domains.name: Model the data
subtopics: Configure table and column properties and implement role-playing dimensions
Define relationship cardinality and cross-filter direction
Create a common date table and implement time intelligence
Create measures with DAX, including CALCULATE and semi-additive measures
Create calculated columns, calculated tables, and calculation groups
Optimize performance by reducing granularity and removing unused columns
Identify poorly performing measures and visuals with Performance Analyzer

domains.name: Visualize and analyze the data
subtopics: Select, format, and configure appropriate visuals
Apply themes, conditional formatting, slicing, and filtering
Configure bookmarks, custom tooltips, and visual interactions
Configure drillthrough navigation, sync slicers, and report navigation
Design for mobile, accessibility, and personalization
Identify patterns with grouping, binning, clustering, and AI visuals
Use reference lines, forecasting, and anomaly detection

domains.name: Manage and secure Power BI
subtopics: Create and configure workspaces and assign workspace roles
Configure and update an app and choose a distribution method
Configure subscriptions, data alerts, and scheduled refresh
Identify when a gateway is required
Promote or certify Power BI content
Implement row-level security roles and group membership
Configure item-level access and apply sensitivity labels
